parameters.question: Compare the reported logistic regression test accuracy (cancer vs normal, 70/30 train-test split). The test accuracy value must match the reference within +/-0.02; column labels and row order may differ.

Compare top 10 most important genes (by absolute logistic regression coefficient) from a cancer vs. normal classifier trained on a 70/30 split. At least 7 of 10 genes must overlap with the reference set (ranks near 10 are solver-sensitive); coefficient values for overlapping genes must be within +/-0.05; column naming and ordering may differ.
